verdict: Lever: Choose Lever when a mid-market ATS+CRM with AI screening is the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need published SMB ATS prices or Greenhouse-depth structured hiring kits. Named AI screening and interview intelligence
bestFor: Mid-market talent teams that want ATS and recruiting CRM together

AI-native all-in-one ATS buyers leaning Ashby

Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth

recommendation: Choose Lever when a mid-market ATS+CRM with AI screening is the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need published SMB ATS prices or Greenhouse-depth structured hiring kits. overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
